projectDescription: A lightweight C/C++ shared library for creating X11 GUI windows with UI elements, image rendering, OpenGL surfaces, and event handling.
keyFeatures: Create fixed or resizable X11 windows with a built-in double-buffered rendering loop
Rich set of retained-mode UI elements: text labels, buttons, text inputs, checkboxes, consoles, images, ellipses, and rectangles
Palette-indexed 16-color rendering system with runtime palette modification
Immediate-mode drawing API for text, rectangles, ellipses, and lines drawn each frame
Pixel-level image canvas with primitives for rects, circles, lines, triangles, and sprites via RLE format
TGA (indexed, RLE) and XBM image format loading with optional palette remapping
GLX-backed OpenGL surface element for embedding OpenGL rendering inside a window
Event callbacks for keyboard, mouse clicks, window close, window resize, and scrolling
Modal dialogs (alert, confirm, input) and scrollable virtual canvas support
Queued task scheduler for one-shot and repeating callbacks
Exposes raw XConnectionData for advanced Xlib integration
